description: About The Team As a Card Product Manager in ShopeePay, you will own the product lifecycle from end to end, turning user needs into innovative features that drive business growth and enhance user experience. This role is perfect for a proactive, data-driven product manager who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment. Job Description Innovate and Shape Product Strategy: Define and execute the product roadmap for our card platform, focusing on both user-facing features and critical operational enhancements. Drive End-to-End Execution: Own the full product development cycle, from ideation and requirements gathering to launch and post-launch analysis. This involves creating detailed PRD, managing timelines, and ensuring successful delivery. Collaborate and Align Stakeholders: Act as the central point of contact, orchestrating seamless collaboration across cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Finance, and Operations. You will be responsible for building consensus and communicating the product vision effectively. Leverage Data for Decisions: Use a data-driven approach to measure product performance, identify new opportunities, and inform strategic decisions. You will conduct quantitative analysis and a/b testing to continuously optimize our products. Become a Card Payments Expert: Gain and apply deep domain knowledge of the card payments ecosystem, including card networks, issuing processes, and industry trends, to ensure our products are competitive and compliant. Requirements Experience: Proven product management experience, preferably in consumer-facing products within fintech or payments. Direct experience with card related products is a significant plus. Technical Acumen: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. You should be technically literate, capable of engaging in technical discussions with engineers and understanding product architecture. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to make data-backed decisions. Proficiency in SQL is preferred. Communication & Leadership: Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills. Have a track record of leading cross-functional teams and projects to successful outcomes. Mindset: Highly organized, self-motivated, and comfortable multitasking in a dynamic, high-growth environment.
title: Product Manager, Cards - ShopeePay

description: eCommerce Manager eCommerce Manager (Digital Growth & Performance) – Bouw aan schaalbare online groei Ben jij een strategische eCommerce specialist met een scherp oog voor data, conversie en digitale groei? Wil je werken met ambitieuze merken en impact maken op schaalbare online strategieën? Dan is dit jouw kans. Over de organisatie Deze snelgroeiende digitale organisatie helpt bedrijven met het realiseren van hoogwaardige online klantreizen en schaalbare eCommerce-oplossingen. Met een team van circa 25–35 specialisten wordt gewerkt aan innovatieve projecten voor nationale en internationale klanten binnen sectoren zoals retail, lifestyle, mobiliteit en zakelijke dienstverlening. De cultuur is ambitieus, resultaatgericht en gericht op continue ontwikkeling. Technologie, data en creativiteit komen hier samen om digitale groei te versnellen. Jouw rol als eCommerce Manager Als eCommerce Manager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en realiseren van digitale groeistrategieën voor meerdere klanten. Je combineert strategisch inzicht met operationele aansturing en bent dé schakel tussen klant, data en uitvoering. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwikkelen van eCommerce strategieën en groeiplannen (roadmaps) Aansturen van multidisciplinaire teams (development, marketing, CRO) Adviseren van stakeholders en management op strategisch niveau Optimaliseren van online performance (conversie, omzet, klantwaarde) Begeleiden van webshoptrajecten, migraties en doorontwikkelingen Signaleren van kansen binnen data, technologie en klantgedrag Je werkt datagedreven en zorgt ervoor dat inzichten worden vertaald naar concrete verbeteracties. Performance & optimalisatie Analyseren van data via tools zoals analytics platforms en dashboards Initiëren en begeleiden van A/B-testen en CRO-trajecten Optimaliseren van customer journeys, funnels en UX Samenwerken met specialisten op het gebied van SEO, SEA, e-mail en paid media Wie ben jij? Je bent analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en weet strategie te vertalen naar resultaat. HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in eCommerce of digital commerce Ervaring met eCommerce-platformen (bijv. Shopify, Magento of vergelijkbaar) Sterk in data-analyse en performance optimalisatie Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten of klanten tegelijk Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden (in NL & EN) Proactief, ondernemend en oplossingsgericht Arbeidsvoorwaarden Salarisindicatie: €3.200 – €5.000 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring) Bonusmogelijkheden op basis van performance Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei Directe impact en verantwoordelijkheid in klanttrajecten Samenwerking met ervaren digital specialisten Moderne werkomgeving in een centrale stedelijke locatie Informele cultuur met focus op kwaliteit en resultaat Waarom deze rol? Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie, technologie en commercie. In deze rol bouw je actief mee aan de digitale groei van diverse organisaties en zie je direct resultaat van jouw werk. Je krijgt vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot een senior eCommerce specialist of digital lead. Interesse? Ben jij klaar om digitale groei naar een hoger niveau te tillen als eCommerce Manager? Solliciteer hieronder!

description: Company Description Krishvi Group is a Bengaluru-based real estate developer with over three decades of experience delivering housing projects for a broad customer base in the “Silicon Valley of India.” Supported by a professional team of technical and financial experts, the group has successfully completed multiple residential developments with a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Krishvi Group is committed to excellence and to shaping future-ready communities that reflect its vision of “aspirational living.” The company continues to build distinctive landmarks in the city, emphasizing quality, reliability, and a signature approach to modern urban housing. Role Description Krishvi Group is looking for a Digital Marketing & Growth Manager to lead and execute digital marketing initiatives across the brand and its residential projects. The role will cover performance marketing, SEO, content, social media, websites, analytics, lead generation and digital brand building . We are looking for a hands-on marketer who can independently manage campaigns, understand customer behaviour, work with agencies and internal teams, analyse performance and translate data into actionable marketing decisions. Key ResponsibilitiesPerformance Marketing Plan, execute and optimise campaigns across Meta, Google Ads and other relevant digital platforms. Develop campaign strategies based on project objectives, inventory, positioning and customer intent. Manage lead-generation campaigns with a strong focus on lead quality and conversion. Monitor CPL, CTR, CPC, conversion rates, qualified leads, site visits and CAC. Analyse campaign performance and optimise budgets, audiences, creatives and campaigns accordingly. Work closely with creative teams to develop and test different creative concepts, messaging and formats. Ensure proper campaign tracking, attribution and conversion measurement. SEO & Organic Growth Develop and execute SEO strategies for the corporate brand and individual projects. Conduct keyword research and identify opportunities for organic growth. Manage on-page, off-page and technical SEO initiatives. Work with Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO tools. Improve organic rankings, qualified traffic and organic enquiries. Develop content strategies based on actual search behaviour. Monitor technical SEO, indexing, Core Web Vitals, sitemap, robots.txt and other website health parameters. Manage and improve local SEO and Google Business Profile presence. Content & Social Media Develop and execute content strategies across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant platforms. Plan content calendars aligned with business and project objectives. Develop content around projects, architecture, lifestyle, location, customer interests and brand stories. Brief and coordinate with designers, photographers, videographers and agencies. Review content for quality, relevance, brand consistency and performance. Understand the role of content across awareness, consideration and conversion. Website & Landing Pages Manage project websites, microsites and campaign landing pages from a marketing perspective. Work with designers and developers to improve UX, CRO and lead-generation journeys. Ensure websites are SEO-friendly, mobile-responsive and conversion-focused. Analyse website behaviour and identify opportunities to improve engagement and conversion. Manage forms, CTAs, pixels, GA4, GTM and conversion events. Lead Generation & CRM Develop and optimise digital lead-generation funnels. Work closely with sales teams to understand lead quality and conversion. Track the customer journey from ad → enquiry → qualified lead → site visit → booking . Identify lead-quality and conversion bottlenecks. Analyse campaign performance against downstream sales outcomes. Coordinate with CRM teams and vendors to ensure accurate lead tracking and attribution. Analytics & Reporting Monitor and analyse digital marketing performance across campaigns and channels. Work with: Google Analytics 4 Google Search Console Google Tag Manager Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Looker Studio / reporting dashboards CRM platforms Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights, observations and recommended actions. Use data to identify opportunities for optimisation and improved marketing efficiency. Project Marketing Support the digital marketing strategy for new project launches and existing developments. Understand the product, audience, positioning, pricing and competitive landscape. Translate project USPs into digital campaigns and customer-facing communication. Develop digital campaign strategies across pre-launch, launch and sustained sales phases. Work closely with sales and marketing teams to align digital activity with inventory and business priorities. Agency & Vendor Management Manage creative, performance marketing, SEO, website, production and other digital partners. Prepare clear briefs and ensure timely execution. Review agency recommendations, reports and deliverables. Track budgets, timelines and deliverables. Challenge agencies where required and ensure accountability for outcomes. Take ownership of execution internally wherever required. Required Skills & Experience 6+ years of experience in digital marketing. Minimum 3 years of experience in real estate marketing . Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads. Strong understanding of SEO and organic growth. Proficiency in GA4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager. Experience managing websites, landing pages and digital funnels. Strong understanding of content marketing and social media. Experience with lead-generation campaigns and CRM workflows. Strong analytical and reporting skills. Experience managing external agencies and vendors. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to independently manage multiple projects and priorities.
title: Digital Marketing & Growth Manager

description: Designation: Affiliate & CRM Manager Central Function: Digital Marketing Location: Dubai, UAE About SUMWON STUDIOS SUMWON STUDIOS is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes MISSGUIDED, SUMWON, BALR, Baby Phat, Playboy, AiiRZ, KiZN, KSTM and 11SKNDS. In just a few years, we have grown from start-up to one of the fastest-scaling brand platforms in the industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital-first world. We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working. The Role The Affiliate & CRM Manager will own the strategy, growth and commercial performance of affiliate and CRM across the SUMWON STUDIOS portfolio. This is an affiliate-led role, with approximately 60–70% of the focus on building and scaling affiliate programmes across the UK and US. The remaining 30–40% will focus on CRM strategy, priorities, campaign planning, testing and agency performance, with execution supported by our specialist CRM agency. We are looking for someone commercially minded who can build strong external partnerships, negotiate effectively, challenge performance and use data to identify where investment will drive genuine incremental growth. Key Responsibilities Affiliate Own the affiliate strategy and growth plan across brands and markets, initially focused on the UK and US. Build and scale affiliate programmes across networks, content publishers, cashback, voucher, loyalty and student partners. Develop partner plans covering recruitment, activation, promotional opportunities and commission structures. Build strong relationships with priority networks and publishers and maintain a strong understanding of the UK and US affiliate landscape. Evaluate partner incrementality, particularly across voucher and cashback partners, to understand genuine new customer acquisition versus existing demand capture. Negotiate commissions, paid placements, media packages and value-add opportunities against clear commercial targets. Develop differentiated affiliate strategies by brand, market, customer and commercial opportunity. Identify new publishers, content partners and market opportunities that can deliver profitable incremental growth. Own affiliate budgets, performance reporting and partner investment decisions, identifying what should be scaled, optimised, renegotiated or stopped. CRM Own the CRM strategy and roadmap across brands and markets, aligned with customer behaviour, trading priorities and commercial targets. Set lifecycle priorities across onboarding, first-to-second order, cross-sell, retention, win-back, loyalty and VIP customers. Define segmentation, personalisation, contact frequency and promotional strategies. Own the CRM agency relationship, setting priorities, briefs and performance expectations and holding the agency accountable for results. Manage the CRM campaign calendar across brands, ensuring activity aligns with trading and product priorities. Build a structured testing and optimisation roadmap across audiences, journeys, content, offers, timing and cadence. Use customer and campaign data to identify opportunities to improve repeat purchase, customer lifetime value and CRM contribution. Ensure performance is measured against relevant commercial and customer metrics, turning insights into clear actions. Identify opportunities to improve customer data, tracking, automation and CRM technology. Own CRM budgets and performance reporting, providing clear recommendations to senior stakeholders. What you’ll bring 4–6 years' experience in affiliate marketing, ecommerce growth, digital partnerships or a similar commercial role. Proven experience building and scaling affiliate programmes across the UK and US. Strong working knowledge of leading affiliate networks and publisher ecosystems, including content, cashback, voucher, loyalty and student partners. Strong commercial understanding of affiliate performance, including commissions, discount costs, placement fees, returns, CPA, ROAS and new versus existing customer contribution. Proven experience negotiating commercial terms, commissions and paid placements to drive profitable growth. Ability to develop and adapt affiliate strategies across multiple brands, markets and customer segments. Strong understanding of CRM and lifecycle marketing, with experience owning strategy, priorities, testing and performance in an agency-led model. Working knowledge of Klaviyo or a comparable CRM platform. Strong analytical, commercial, communication and relationship-management skills. Experience within fashion, retail or a multi-brand ecommerce environment is desirable. A hands-on, commercially driven approach with the ability to operate independently and challenge performance when required. Success in the Role Success will be measured by the ability to: Grow affiliate revenue and profitable new customer acquisition across priority markets. Build a strong, high-quality publisher and partner portfolio. Improve affiliate incrementality and commercial efficiency. Increase CRM contribution, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value. Deliver a clear and effective testing roadmap across affiliate and CRM. Hold external partners and agencies accountable for measurable commercial results. Identify and act on opportunities that drive profitable growth across the SUMWON STUDIOS portfolio. What we'll bring 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands Ongoing learning and development opportunities Company social events The opportunity to work with a high-performing team building brands at global scale Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi-brand platform operating across global markets.
title: Affiliate & CRM Manager
